text: [57] dasayimā bhikkhave saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā #1 yu. sabbesuyeva . honti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānā katamā dasa aniccasaññā anattasaññā maraṇasaññā āhāre paṭikkulasaññā sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā aṭṭhikasaññā puḷuvakasaññā 1 vinīlakasaññāฅ vicchiddakasaññā uddhūmātakasaññā imā kho bhikkhave dasa saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti .
